scope: Current cloud Linux container-visible host/kernel resources; loopback HTTP export only. No physical GPU, RDMA device, workload, real storage backend, or induced pressure verified.
cleanup: Exporter terminated after evidence collection; no persistent service or systemwide installation.
default_collector_startup: blocked: official node_exporter1.9.1 default startup panics because /sys does not exist in this execution sandbox
limitations: No /sys, so CPU/diskstats/default collector startup cannot be validated without changing the observed source.
/proc/pressure missing: PSI no series, collector success=0, not zero pressure.
Time collector emits node_time_seconds but fails additional clock fields: inspect source error, do not infer synced clock.
Network observed interface is the container-visible loopback only, not a physical NIC or RDMA link.
Filesystem values are container-visible mounts; not validation of storage hardware or per-workload IO.
